function: RIS passive beamforming: an MLP on the RIS controller predicts each DFT codeword's rate from CSI at a few active elements, then picks the best (p. 2, 5).
system: Single-antenna BS and UE, semi-passive reflecting RIS of 64x64 or 32x32 elements with 1 to 28 active sensing elements, 28 GHz, 512 OFDM subcarriers, 100 MHz (p. 3, 7).
method: Supervised MLP (fully connected, ReLU, up to 3 hidden layers) regressing rate per codeword; offline MSE training; INT8 post-training quantization; inference on MCUs with TFLM (p. 8-10).
data_channel: DeepMIMO O1 ray-tracing scenario (Wireless InSite) at 28 GHz, 36,200 UE locations; 30,000 train, 3,100 validation, 3,100 test samples (p. 6-7).
test_conditions: Random 30,000/3,100/3,100 split of one DeepMIMO O1 scenario; ten datasets (two RIS sizes, five active-element counts), a model trained on each (p. 7, 11).
baselines: Genie-aided exhaustive search with perfect CSI (non-learned); learned: MLP of [10] (G=1), re-implemented; FP32, INT8 and on-MCU variants of the proposed model (p. 9, 13).
metrics: Predicted achievable rate (bps/Hz) and rate drop from genie to FP32 to INT8 to MCU; MCU execution latency; Pareto fronts (p. 9, 12-15).
complexity: Measured MCU latency averaged over 3000 test samples, 0.217 to 276.9 ms (Table 3); tensor arena 32-128 KB; no MAC or parameter counts (p. 10, 12-13).
openness: Code at https://github.com/LucaUrbinati44/DL-on-RISC/ (p. 3, 17); data: public DeepMIMO O1 scenario (p. 5-6).
q1_support: p. 5: "we use the open-source DeepMIMO dataset [47]"; p. 6: "we adopt the outdoor ray-tracing scenario" O1, built with Wireless InSite ray tracing.
q2_support: p. 7: "we randomly shuffle and split each DL Dataset in three sets" (a held-out part of the same scenario); p. 16 lists "executing more studies across diverse propagation conditions and mobility profiles" as future work.
q3_support: p. 9: "(i) a genie-aided scheme" (exhaustive search with perfect CSI, non-learned) and "(ii) the original approach by the authors of [10] and [63]" (learned), compared in achievable rate (Fig. 5).
q4_support: p. 12: "The reported MCU execution latency is averaged over 3000 test samples"; Table 3 (p. 13) lists latency in ms. No parameter or MAC counts are given.
q5_support: p. 3: "We open source our code to ease reproducibility and foster new experimental research on DL-on-RISC [52]"; link in ref. [52], p. 17: "https://github.com/LucaUrbinati44/DL-on-RISC/"; public DeepMIMO data (p. 5).
notes: Include, area 3: RIS codebook selection, with a hardware-aware latency study built around it; a RIS is present, so the single-antenna exclusion does not apply. q2 is 0: random split of one scenario, and field channels and diverse conditions are future work (p. 16). q3 counts the genie-aided exhaustive search, an upper bound, as the non-learned comparator; flagged for the reviewer. The G=1 models of [10] are compared on rate and latency (p. 13). GitHub link not opened.
